_about: Multi-question sessions for `node bench/run.js --mode sessions` (stage 0.4.1 of the v0.5 engine roadmap): each session groups a few questions of bench/questions.json that are asked IN ORDER inside the SAME claude -p call (one MCP session), so dedupe/toc/context-reuse levers have something to reuse across turns. `questions` are ids from bench/questions.json, checked at load time (unknown id = hard error). Topics 'kestrel', 'harbor', 'orchard' and 'lantern' share a note across their questions on purpose (the second question can reuse what the first already read); 'ops-reference' and 'clients' group otherwise-unrelated questions from the same demo memory, as a baseline for how much a session helps when there is nothing to reuse.
